paite: Huchi in ka thuakzoh tak louh phet un Athen ah koumau kia nutsiat in om le ung hoih ka sa ua,
heading: Timothi Nasepna

paite: i unaupa uh Timothi ahihleh Khrist tanchinhoih lam a Pathian nasempa, nou hon hihkip ding leh na ginna lam ua nou hon khamuan ding in ka hon sawlta uhi.
Hiai gimthuaknate ziak a kuamah alinlouhna ding un. Hiaite bang thuak ding a seh ka hi uh chih noumau ngei in na thei uhi.
Na kiang ua ka om lai ua gimthuak ding ka hi uh chih ka hon hilhkholh bang ngei in atungta hi, huai na thei uhi.
Hiai ziak in, ka thuakzoh tak louh nung in, khempa'n nou ahon khempuk kha dia, ka sepgimna uh athawn kha ding chi in na gindan uh ka na theihna ding in mi ka hon sawl ahi.

Himahleh Timothi, noumau a kipan a tua ka kiang uh ahong tun in, hon muh ka ut mahmah bang un nou leng hon muh ut mahmah in hehpih in na hon theigige uh chih leh na ginna uh leh na itna tanchin uh kipahhuaitak mai ahon puak hi.
Huchi ahih ziak in unaute aw, ka mangbatna uleh gimthuakna tengteng uah na ginna ziak un na tungthu uah lungmuan in ka omta uhi.
Toupa a na dinkip phot uleh tu'n tuh ka hingta uhi.
I Pathian ma ah na tung ua ka kipahna tengteng ziak un noumau lam thu ah Pathian kiang ah bangchibang in kipahthu ka gen thei zozen ding uam aw?
Na mel uh ka muhtheihna ding uleh na ginna lam ua na taksap awng uh ka hon huksak theihna ding un sun leh zan in nakpitak in ka thum uhi.
Huchi in Pathian, i Pa ngei leh Toupa Jesu'n leng, koute na kiang uah hon pitung hen.
heading: Thumna

paite: Huan noumau lam a itna ka hauh bang un, noumau khat-le-khat na ki-ittuah chiatna uleh mi tengteng na itna uh hon khangsak zelpa Toupa'n hon hausak semsem hen;
huchi a i Toupa Jesu, amisiangthou tengteng toh ahong pai chiang a, i Pathian leh a Pa ma a na lungtangte uh sianthouna lam ah gensiatbei a om ding a nou ahon hihkip theihna ding in.
